dedupe_keys.name: sunass regulatory benchmarking of peruvian water utilities eps

description: SUNASS produced the results of its regulatory benchmarking of Peru's water and sanitation utilities (EPS), an online tool with the main performance indicators, such as service continuity and pressure, which can be filtered by utility. Coverage is Peru's utilities nationwide, and the page presents the tool as the Sunass evaluation of utility performance through the main regulatory indicators. The tool is free to use online. Caveats: the page does not list every indicator, the years covered or an export format. Simulation uses: utility continuity and pressure baselines for service performance and resilience studies. Related records: the SUNASS treatment plant platform (data-sunass-peru-wastewater-treatment-plants).
